about.title: Born and raised in Dhaka
about.text: I grew up in Dhaka and completed my SSC 10th grade in 2019.

about.title: Started working in 2019
about.text: Due to family financial needs, I joined the workforce right after SSC and have been working continuously from 2019 until October 2025.

about.title: Current job
about.text: I work as a Junior Operator at a water treatment plant — a role that taught me responsibility, time management, and hands-on problem solving.

about.title: A lifelong interest in tech
about.text: I’ve loved technology since childhood — from Nokia 3310/5310 phones to using the internet on my dad’s phone before 3G/4G. I got my first computer at eight, and that curiosity never left.

about.title: Learning programming
about.text: I began studying programming seriously in 2023 while working full-time, following tutorials and building small projects in my free time.

about.title: Education — now and next steps
about.text: I completed my Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) in the Arts stream in 2026. Now that I’m more financially stable, I plan to enroll in a diploma in Computer Science.

about.title: Continuous learner
about.text: Because technology keeps changing, I’m always learning — from front-end and back-end basics to new frameworks and tools. I love exploring everything about tech.

about.title: Future interests
about.text: I’m particularly excited to study LLMs, AI, and Python to expand my skill set and work on smarter, more useful applications.

about.title: Career goal
about.text: My dream is to become a full-time programmer, building practical, user-friendly web applications that solve real problems.
